items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: Fowlin' Louis Armstrong, and, oh, Tailgate Wagon, Buddy P.T. and all them cats like that.

ctx.x: The date exactly? 1907 on the 25th of December. I have my birthday with Jesus Christ. That's why I'm a lucky boy. So nobody that makes me don't get nothing on birthday anymore than what I'm supposed to get eaten and things like that. That's everybody that has that day, you know. So, well, that's speaking and going on. I'm not talking about music and things like that. Well, I've been around, you know what I mean? I've been around. And Louis Armstrong, I was a very young kid. Of course, when I started bass, I was,…
Did you play with parade bands?
